whatIs.title: What is a cookie?
whatIs.description: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, smartphone, tablet) when you visit a website. It stores information about your browsing and recognizes you on your next visits.

types.title: Essential cookies
types.description: Necessary for the site to function. They cannot be disabled.

types.title: Analytics cookies
types.description: Help us understand how you use the site so we can improve it.

types.title: Marketing cookies
types.description: Used to show you relevant advertisements.

retention.title: Retention period
retention.description: The retention period for cookies varies by type:

thirdParty.label: Third-party cookies:
thirdParty.value: duration set by the third party concerned

options: Via the cookie banner on your first visit
